sentences.text: By way of the present petition filed under section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, the petitioner seeks quashing of case FIR No. 0349/2018 dated 28.06.2018 registered under sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Shalimar Bagh ('subject FIR'), based on mediated settlement dated 26.08.2023 arrived at under the aegis of the Mediation Centre, Rohini District Courts, Delhi.

Mr. Gajendra Pal Singh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits, that despite having settled the matter in mediation and a divorce decree having been passed by the learned Judge,
Family Court, Rohini District Court, Delhi on mutual consent vide order dated 04.12.2023,
respondent No.2 is not cooperating in the quashing of the subject FIR.
Issue notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
